steps.instruction: 先標出「交付控制模型」的座標、光／電／熱輸入與輸出。控制器需要功率—相位曲線、動態、串擾與工作範圍，而非只有 Pπ。 用至少兩個設計狀態比較本單元變數，寫出能被量測推翻的預測；在工作台依師傅示意判讀相關介面，保留假設與未知參數。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the coordinates and optical/electrical/thermal inputs and outputs for deliver a control model. A controller needs power-phase curves, dynamics, crosstalk and bounds, not only Pπ. Compare at least two design states and write a prediction that measurement could falsify. Review the relevant interfaces with the mentor view and preserve assumptions and unknown parameters.
steps.observation: 以新相位目標測收斂時間、過衝與保持誤差。
steps.observationEn: Test settling, overshoot and hold error at a new phase target.
steps.failure: 錯誤推論「知道 Pπ 即可完成所有控制設計」可能使本步驗收失真。若結果不符，先檢查量測基準及模型邊界，再按本步診斷量分離原因；不能只調參讓曲線重合。
steps.failureEn: The incorrect inference "Pπ alone completes control design" can invalidate acceptance. If results disagree, check references and model validity, then separate causes using this step’s diagnostic rather than merely fitting parameters.
steps.check: 提交交付控制模型的變數表、兩種狀態與量測判別紀錄：以新相位目標測收斂時間、過衝與保持誤差。 寫明剩餘不確定度與不支持的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit variables, two states and a measurement-discrimination record for deliver a control model: Test settling, overshoot and hold error at a new phase target. State remaining uncertainty and unsupported conclusions.

knowledge.title: 定量算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 假設均勻有效熱光係數 dn_eff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹、L=1 mm、λ=1.55 μm，ΔTπ=λ/(2L·dn_eff/dT)=4.306 K。若集總 R_th=200 K/W，Pπ=21.53 mW；再假設 C_th=10 μJ/K，τ=R_thC_th=2.00 ms。 係數是有效模態係數而非純材料值，溫度視為均勻；R_th、C_th 為同一集總熱節點，真實結構可能有多個時間常數及溫度相依電阻。
knowledge.textEn: With hypothetical uniform effective dn_eff/dT=1.8×10⁻⁴ K⁻¹, L=1 mm and λ=1.55 μm, ΔTπ=4.306 K. A lumped R_th=200 K/W gives Pπ=21.53 mW; assumed C_th=10 μJ/K gives τ=2.00 ms. The coefficient is modal rather than purely material and temperature is uniform. R_th/C_th describe one lumped thermal node; real structures can have multiple time constants and temperature-dependent resistance.
